preservation.method: The selected generated pigment rectangle was copied onto the recovered ancestor; all pixels outside that rectangle were retained directly from the ancestor.

generation.tool: built-in image generator and standard-library PNG compositor
generation.prompt_summary: Three tiny ochre reed bundles with charcoal ties and dots, on an empty lower-rock pocket, with every inherited cave mark preserved.

visual_review: Inspected the final PNG. The inherited cave remains square, rough warm rock under torchlight, and its framing is unchanged. Pepe remains a burnt-stick cave figure with wide mouth, heavy-lidded eyes, and two hands visibly drawn with four fingers and one thumb each. The added three tied bundles are earth-pigment marks on vacant lower rock. No letters, numerals, captions, signatures, logos, watermarks, borders, frames, real people, political or hateful symbols, handprints, photographs, or 3D renders are visible.
limitations: Visual review is local rather than independent certification; the new mark was composed from a bounded generated patch to preserve the ancestor outside it.
